Package com.robojacks.lib.command

package com.robojacks.lib.command
  • Class
    Description
    Command
    Base class for commands.
    Command.InterruptionBehavior
     
    Commands
    Static command factories, same names as WPILib's Commands class.
    CommandScheduler
    Runs subsystems, button bindings and commands once per loop.
    ConditionalCommand
    Chooses between two commands when it starts.
    DeferredCommand
    Builds a fresh command every time it's scheduled.
    FunctionalCommand
    A command built from lambdas.
    InstantCommand
    Runs once and finishes immediately.
    ParallelCommandGroup
    Runs commands at the same time; ends when ALL have finished.
    ParallelDeadlineGroup
    Runs commands at the same time; ends when the DEADLINE command finishes.
    ParallelRaceGroup
    Runs commands at the same time; ends when ANY one finishes (the rest are interrupted).
    RunCommand
    Runs an action every loop until interrupted.
    SequentialCommandGroup
    Runs commands one after another.
    Subsystem
    Same idea as WPILib's Subsystem: owns hardware, at most one command uses it at a time.
    SubsystemBase
    Extend this for your subsystems.
    Trigger
    Binds commands to a condition (usually a button).
    WaitCommand
    Finishes after a fixed time.
    WaitUntilCommand
    Finishes when a condition becomes true.
